title: Securing of entrances after search.
bodyText: Each county police department, the department of law enforcement, and any state or county public body that employs law enforcement officers shall develop a policy for securing the entrances to a house, store, or other building designated as a place to be searched after a search is completed.
bodyHtml: [§803-40]  Securing of entrances after search.  Each county police department, the department of law enforcement, and any state or county public body that employs law enforcement officers shall develop a policy for securing the entrances to a house, store, or other building designated as a place to be searched after a search is completed. [L 2025, c 245, pt of §1]
